sub.label: Title
prompts: State the proposal title (max 200 chars).

sub.label: Participants
prompts: Coordinator + affiliated entities with explained link + role.

sub.label: EIC topic selection
prompts: Choose ONE: (1) EIC Accelerator Open OR (2) one of the 5 Challenges 2026:
2.1 Advanced Materials for Renewable Energy and Energy Storage System
2.2 Alternative Concepts and Key Enabling Technologies for Fusion Power Plants
2.3 Biotech for Regenerating Agricultural Soils
2.4 Boosting the European Critical Raw Materials value chain
2.5 Deep Tech for Climate Adaptation
If you opt for a Challenge: describe how your application fits within the scope and how it will meet the expected outcomes + impacts.

sub.label: Executive summary
prompts: Half-page summary: technology + market + team + ask. Written to hook the evaluators.

sub.label: 1.1 Novelty + breakthrough nature
prompts: Describe how your innovation is deep-tech.
Describe the novelty and disruptive potential vs existing solutions.
Provide empirical data that demonstrate the novelty + potential to disrupt current markets.

sub.label: 1.2 Technology maturity (TRL)
prompts: Has the innovation completed all aspects of TRL 5 (validation in a relevant environment)?
Provide evidence of TRL 5 (or higher) validation.

sub.label: 1.3 IP strategy
prompts: IP strategy in terms of patents (granted/pending), trade secrets, other IP elements, FTO status.
Upload the FTO analysis as an annex OR a 2-page max note explaining why it is not relevant (e.g. software).

sub.label: 2.1 Market opportunity
prompts: TAM/SAM/SOM; share target; GTM strategy; customer value proposition; partnerships.

sub.label: 2.2 Business + revenue model + growth strategy
prompts: Detailed business model and revenue strategy.
Financial projections  assumptions, drivers, sensitivity.
How will you achieve your planned revenues?

sub.label: 2.3 Broader impact (EU leadership + dependency reduction)
prompts: Will your innovation contribute to European technological leadership and/or reduce dependencies on other regions?
Broader environmental or social impacts?
Clarify how it reduces dependency on non-EU sources for critical technologies or raw materials.

sub.label: 2.4 Challenge alignment (Challenges only)
prompts: How does your innovation contribute to the Challenge objectives? Which metrics will you use to measure such contribution?

sub.label: 2.5 STEP Impact (only for Challenges within STEP scope)
prompts: Will your innovation have a clear and measurable impact on STEP technology areas? Choose:
- Bringing to the Union's internal market an innovative, emerging and cutting-edge innovation with significant economic potential; OR
- Reducing or preventing strategic dependencies of the Union.
Applicants from Associated Countries: demonstrate contributions to the EU internal market or strategic dependencies.
Which metrics will you use to measure such impact?

sub.label: 3.1 Team Capability (with team + governance tables)
prompts: Necessary team in terms of skills + competences to develop + scale the innovation.
Governance + decision-making + incentivisation (e.g. ESOP plan).
Current skills/competence gaps incl. gender balance + plan to fill them.
Team table: Name | Gender | Founder Y/N | Position | Key competences | % commitment.
Governance table: Name | Type (founder/investor/other) | % fully diluted.

sub.label: 3.2 Risk level + leverage effect (conditional on funding mode)
prompts: Have you demonstrated early traction with investors? Is the financing requirement to be internationally competitive significantly higher than what market actors alone can finance?
Describe your traction with investors + the timing + size of your future financing round.
Explain why you need EIC funding + why market actors will not commit alone.

conditional_prompts.grant-only: FOR GRANT ONLY: describe how you will commercialise and scale up the innovation. Demonstrate access to the resources needed.
conditional_prompts.equity-only: FOR EQUITY ONLY: will the EIC Fund investment be able to catalyse other public + private investment within 6 months to 2 years?
conditional_prompts.blended: FOR BLENDED FINANCE: catalyse public + private investment within 6–24 months PLUS justify the lump-sum grant component.

sub.label: 3.3 Risk management
prompts: Technological, market, financial, regulatory risks + mitigation.
How your innovation is compliant with industry standards + how you account for future regulations.

sub.label: Online CV links
prompts: Link to online CVs for key team members (LinkedIn, company website, etc.).

documents.title: Pitch deck (PDF, 10-min oral cap at face-to-face interview)
Video pitch script (3 min  can reuse Stage 1)
Lump Sum detailed budget breakdown (mandatory for grant-only + blended)
Implementation plan (10 pages max  mandatory for grant + blended)

sections.label: Work Packages
prompts: Define each WP: objectives, lead beneficiary, person-months, deliverables, dependencies.

sections.label: Milestones + timing
prompts: Critical milestones; quarter-by-quarter timeline; go/no-go gates.

sections.label: Deliverables
prompts: Each deliverable: ID, title, lead, delivery month, dissemination level.

sections.label: Resources + costs
prompts: Personnel, subcontracting, equipment, travel, indirect costs (25% flat).

documents.title: Ownership control declaration
documents.note: Required ONLY for Challenge 2.4 Critical Raw Materials value chain + Open proposals in the same scope requesting GRANT ONLY.

documents.title: Essential information for clinical studies / trials / investigations
documents.note: Modular extension  only if the project includes clinical studies/trials/investigations under CTR 536/2014 or MDR 2017/745 or IVDR 2017/746.

hand_offs.chat_cta: Ask Brubru for help with the conditional Section 3.2 paragraph for your funding mode
hand_offs.comply_cta: Run EU Law Comply for your topic + ethics flags
